inventory.source: PatchLoader.Jar enumeration of the official pinned MPP, filtered by exact YouTube package compatibility; source symbols verified against the pinned revision.

integration.original_named_exports: All original named patches become unnamed dependencies; root named wrappers provide user selection.
integration.wrapper_contract: For decision=expose, dependsOn(original_expression, morpheSettingsBridgePatch), forwards original options, and marks the morphe-* id installed with empty Afterglow preference keys.
integration.existing_wrapper_contract: For decision=delegate_existing, reuse existing_wrapper_id and delegate to the original dependency graph once.
integration.selection_defaults: Default-selected and runtime-enabled are separate. Original runtime defaults and existing morphe_prefs values are preserved.
integration.shared_settings: Retain the complete original settings resources, startup initialization and extension graph; expose imported UI through the Afterglow settings bridge.
integration.branding: Exclude Custom branding and Change header exports and their unlicensed/logo source assets.
integration.exclusive_service_ownership: Afterglow owns SponsorBlock and Downloads and Vault. Morphe Downloads is not exported. Original Hide ads can still enter through optional Channel whitelist; this dependency exception is explicit.
integration.validation_status: Catalog and source inventory only; compile, strict patch application and device behavior are separate integration gates.
